title: The owner can park any open question or task on the waiting page
why: Owner ask ask-mw3lh382c9, Nov 5 07:41 CST: "i should be able to add park to any question". Today only the writer can park an item, through meta/page.parked; the owner can only unpark or drop a parked line (step page-parked-actions).
note: Fix, one lane, waiting-page only, designer first: each open decision and task card gets a Park press beside None of these. Pressing it and Send saves answers/<id> with act park; the writer moves the item into meta/page.parked (with its ref and the owner's note) and the card leaves the list; Unpark brings it back as today. Reuse the parked-line code (one home). Interim until it lands: the owner writes "park <n>" in a note or an ask, and triage parks it by hand. Needs no answer.
